needs.source: TI OPAx991 data sheet SBOS969F (January 2022), 10.1 Layout Guidelines: low-ESR 0.1-µF ceramic bypass capacitors between each supply pin and ground, close to the device

hints: rail-to-rail input from two input pairs: between (V+) − 2 V and (V+) − 1 V both are on – offset, CMRR, noise and THD are worse there (7.3.5); bias an audio stage at mid supply, below (V+) − 2 V
capacitive load drive 1 nF (6.7); larger loads – a long cable – with an isolation resistor RISO in series with the output (7.3.4, figure 7-5: 50 Ω)
no phase reversal beyond the input range (figure 6-30); inputs more than 0.5 V beyond the rails: limit the current to 10 mA (6.1 note 3)
